source.island_status_source: EuPPollNet manuscript pre-existing island_studies vector includes 31_Roberts

source_native_design.interaction_schedule_rule: all interaction dates must be a subset of the eight flower-count schedule dates; flower-only dates are retained as zero-interaction bins

time_bin: source-native flower-count calendar date within Site_id
partner_identity: source-native Pollinator_species after whitespace normalization; source processing exclusions for unknown pollinators are retained
interaction_value: sum of nonnegative source-native Interaction counts by Site_id x date x Pollinator_species
effort: 30 minutes per Site_id x source-native round; 300 m2 sampled area is constant and retained as a structural cross-check
excluded_system_rule: All remaining UK Site_id values are excluded before coordinate computation because the public flower-count schedule does not preserve all four rounds in each of both source-declared years; no missing round is imputed from interaction-positive dates.
prohibited_after_freeze: add any of the other UK sites by using interaction-positive dates in place of missing source-native rounds
drop Carlisle, Livingstone_far, or Livingstone_house based on D1 or phi
split the eight source-native rounds into finer bins
merge the eight source-native rounds after seeing coordinates
change the interaction value away from source-native Interaction counts
change partner identity based on downstream synchrony
reclassify the source as island or mainland based on its route effect
claim_boundary: Three England STEP sites are admitted as three systems from one independent source study and one Great Britain continental-island group. EuPPollNet's own manuscript classified 31_Roberts as an island study before this Chapter 2 search. Admission is based only on source design, complete eight-round flower-count schedules, raw equal effort, time-bin count and nonconstant partner-series count. No D1, phi or route value was opened before this freeze.
